resources.string: Opson uses these to estimate the energy your body uses in a day. Only you see them.
Opson uses these quietly, to keep your targets sensible in the background.
The energy formula is a little different for each. This only changes the estimate.
Adds the extra energy pregnancy needs to your estimate. Opson won't plan any weight change while you're pregnant.
Adds the extra energy breastfeeding needs to your estimate. Opson won't plan any weight change while you're breastfeeding.
Uses a point halfway between the two formulas. This only changes the estimate a little.
Trans or non-binary? Pick whichever is closer to your body's hormones right now, or what your care team suggests. It only nudges the estimate, and you can change it any time on Profile.
Age changes the estimate. Opson might wish you a happy birthday, too.
How active is a usual day?
Outside of workouts. Pick the one closest to most of your days.
%1$s tells Opson how active you are each day, so there's nothing to pick here.
Or connect %1$s and let your phone or watch fill this in.
What would you like to aim for?
Opson works out each day's target from this. You can change it any time.
Eat around what your body uses
For building muscle or getting back to your weight
No weight goal. Log and see how it goes.
Add your weight on the step before to set a goal weight.
That's above your weight now. Pick Gain weight if that's the goal.
That's below your weight now. Pick Lose weight if that's the goal.
That's below a healthy weight range for your height. Opson will still help you log, and if you'd like to talk it through with someone, support is close by.
Slower is easier to keep up, and you can change it later.

About %1$s a day more than you use
This is the fastest pace Opson plans. Faster is harder on your body and harder to keep up.
Opson won't plan a pace from here, so it will keep each day's target around what you use. You can talk to someone about what's right for you any time.
Worked out with the usual rule of thumb, about 3,500 calories to a pound (7,700 to a kilogram). It's an estimate, and real change is usually slower.
Worked out with the usual rule of thumb for how much energy a pound of body weight holds. It's an estimate, and real change is usually slower.
Here's what Opson will aim for, from what you told it.
A rough guide, not a promise. Weight usually changes more slowly over time.

About %1$s more than you use on a typical day
About what you use on a typical day
Every number here is an estimate. How you feel and your weight over a few weeks are the best guides, and you can adjust it any time in Targets.
Opson sets your daily targets from this in the background, so you won't see a calorie number.
Add your birthday, height and weight on Profile and Opson can work out a daily target for you.
Your targets stay as they are. You can change them any time in Targets.
No weight goal for now. Opson starts you on a daily target from what you use on a typical day.
While you're pregnant, Opson won't plan any weight change. Your daily target includes the extra energy you need.
While you're breastfeeding, Opson won't plan any weight change. Your daily target includes the extra energy you need.
Your midwife or doctor can help with what's right for you.
Opson will help you eat regularly and notice how meals feel. Targets work quietly in the background, and you can change what you see any time in Modes.
Small, steady days add up. Opson will be here for each one, the easy ones and the harder ones.
Opson is here to help you look after yourself, one meal at a time. There's no wrong way to do this.
You can change any of this later.

Tell Opson a little about you and what you'd like to aim for, and it will work out each day's target.
